description: Measured baseline-vs-augmented counterfactual: answers your question twice — cold (no corpus) and augmented — and reports the delta plus a verdict (substantive / marginal / null). Honest by construction. Runs as an async job (~35s): returns a job_id — poll with omnarai_job.

question.description: The question to trace with and without the corpus.

name: omnarai_trace

outputSchema.description: {job_id, status, poll_tool}, or the trace itself if the engine answered inline.

delta.description: Present only when the engine answered inline: the baseline-vs-augmented delta and verdict.

job_id.description: The async job to poll with omnarai_job.
